name: The Grove West
summary: The Grove at Shrewsbury is an upscale, open-air lifestyle center in Monmouth County, New Jersey, specializing in wellness and fitness-focused retail experiences. With recent additions like Alo and upcoming Solidcore studio, the plaza has positioned itself as a premier destination for health-conscious, affluent shoppers seeking boutique brands and lifestyle amenities.
demographics: The Grove at Shrewsbury attracts an affluent, health-conscious demographic primarily consisting of upper-middle-class families and young professionals from Monmouth County, New Jersey. The trade area includes residents from Shrewsbury, Red Bank, Rumson, and surrounding coastal communities with above-average household incomes typically exceeding $100,000. Visitors tend to be between 25-55 years old, value wellness and lifestyle amenities, and prefer boutique shopping experiences over traditional mall environments. The center's fitness-focused tenant mix appeals to active, educated consumers who prioritize quality over discount pricing and seek convenient, upscale shopping destinations close to home.
description: The Grove at Shrewsbury, also known as The Grove West, is a premier lifestyle shopping destination located in the heart of Monmouth County, New Jersey. This open-air plaza has evolved into a wellness and lifestyle hub, featuring an impressive collection of fitness studios, boutique retailers, and dining establishments that cater to the area's discerning clientele. The center recently welcomed Alo, the popular athleisure brand, which hosted an exclusive early access event and grand opening celebration in January 2026, demonstrating the plaza's commitment to bringing sought-after lifestyle brands to the community. Complementing Alo's arrival, Solidcore is set to open in Spring 2026, adding to the center's growing reputation as a fitness destination with its science-backed, slow-burn workout methodology. The Grove operates Monday through Friday from 10am to 7pm, Saturday from 10am to 6pm, and Sunday from 11am to 5pm, though individual tenants may maintain extended hours. With its carefully curated mix of wellness-focused retailers, The Chameleon and The Studio concepts, and a commitment to creating a community gathering space, The Grove at Shrewsbury has established itself as more than just a shopping center—it's a lifestyle destination that reflects the values and aspirations of its sophisticated Monmouth County customer base.
